caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a metallic tankard or mug with a lid and a decorative handle. The main body of the tankard is cylindrical and shaded in dark gray to black, indicating a metallic surface with some reflected light areas rendered in lighter gray. The lid is conical with a flat top, matching the same metallic color and finish as the body. Attached to the top of the lid is a vertical finial colored yellow-ochre, which is elongated and rounded at the top. The handle is ornate, curving outwards and then looping back towards the body of the tankard, also shaded in dark gray to black. The tankard sits on a slightly raised, circular base, consistent in color with the body. All these elements are centered within a fine, rectangular border drawn in black line. The background is plain parchment or beige, with the signature "Eugene J. Bernell" written in the bottom right corner just outside the main border.
title: Lamp
